module.title: Days 1–10 | Competition Mastery Module
module.description: Production candidate: authored topic-driven GK Challenge curriculum.

lessons.title: India geography & polity basics
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of india geography & polity basics and apply it accurately to unfamiliar questions.
lessons.core_teaching_content: General knowledge requires accurate recall plus disciplined verification. Separate stable facts from time-sensitive information, distinguish institutions from office-holders, and read question wording carefully. Geography, history, science, economy, culture and sport often overlap, so use category clues before selecting an answer. When a question contains dates, rankings or current positions, identify the relevant time frame. Good preparation builds connected knowledge rather than isolated lists. In this lesson, focus specifically on india geography & polity basics. Identify the defining concepts, the distinctions that commonly cause mistakes, and the evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer. Practise moving from recognition to application: first identify what the question is testing, then select a method, perform the reasoning carefully, and verify the result against the wording and constraints. Keep an error log that records the misconception or decision error, not just the correct answer.
examples: A GK Challenge question on india geography & polity basics should be solved by identifying the key clue, applying the relevant principle, and checking the option against all stated conditions.
Create a new india geography & polity basics scenario with one tempting distractor. Explain why the correct response is supported and why the distractor fails.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused GK Challenge activity on india geography & polity basics. Build a small table, diagram, worked example, speaking sample, writing sample or practice set as appropriate to the subject, then explain the reasoning behind the result.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on india geography & polity basics: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent justification on the third. Ask the learner to identify the exact clue, rule or evidence used before confirming the answer.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar questions on india geography & polity basics without viewing the answer.
Create one new example and solve it using the lesson method.
Review one distractor or error and explain why it is wrong.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item GK Challenge checkpoint focused on india geography & polity basics. Target at least six correct and justify every uncertain response.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished GK Challenge task demonstrating india geography & polity basics and record the reasoning, evidence or performance criteria used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach the learner toward evidence-based reasoning and precise terminology. Ask for the method before giving correction, and turn each error into a reusable rule or practice target. This lesson remains suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one mistake pattern and one concrete action for improving india geography & polity basics in the next practice session.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
